title: Cosmic consciousness is prior to ordinary consciousness

statements.text: The consciousness of the cosmos is ontologically prior to, more fundamental than, the consciousness of ordinary individuals, and is the most fundamental form of phenomenality. Every other consciousness is derivative of it, as every concrete object is derivative of the cosmos on priority monism.

sources.quote: the consciousness of the cosmos is ontologically prior to the consciousness of ordinary individuals like us
the cosmic consciousness is the most fundamental form of phenomenality
